name: Senjuushi: Rhodoknight
source:
The Gun Knights are the spirits of historic firearms, given human form. They are bound to their Masters and fight alongside them. Each Gun Knight carries the memories and legacy of the battles they were part of, and their personalities reflect the history and character of the firearms they embody.

The world was once ruled by the tyrannical World Emperor, who subjugated nations through sheer military might. After his fall, the nations of the world regained their independence, but the scars of war remained. The sudden appearance of Brown Bess at the British Queen's coronation signaled a new era—one in which nations would seek out and awaken their own Gun Knights to serve as both guardians and national symbols.

These Gun Knights are not merely weapons; they are companions, warriors, and living embodiments of history. Each has their own will, their own sense of pride, and their own reasons for fighting alongside their Master.
translation:
枪骑士是历史上火器的灵魂，被赋予了人形。他们与他们的主人紧密相连，并与他们并肩作战。每个枪骑士都承载着他们所参与的战斗的记忆和遗产，他们的个性反映了他们所代表的枪支的历史和特征。

世界曾经由残暴的世界皇帝统治，他以纯粹的军事力量征服国家。他倒台后，世界各国重新获得独立，但战争的伤痕依然存在。布朗·贝斯在英国女王加冕典礼上的突然出现标志着一个新时代的到来——在这个时代中，各国将寻找并唤醒自己的枪骑士，以充当守护者和国家象征。

这些枪骑士不仅仅是武器，更是武器。他们是同伴、战士，是历史的活生生的化身。每个人都有自己的意志，自己的自豪感，以及与主人并肩作战的理由。
